.Basic usage
======
[tp-javascript-notebook]
=====
[script,type="tp/markdown"]
====
# Interactive JavaScript

Select **Run all cells** to execute the program. Use the code button in a cell to edit its source.
====

====
console.log('Hello from JavaScript');
====
=====
======

.Javascript API
======
[script,type="module"]
====
import "/components/javascript-notebook/javascript-notebook.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-javascript-notebook");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n    "));

const element2 = document.createElement("script");
element2.setAttribute("type", "tp/markdown");
element2.textContent = "# Interactive JavaScript\n\nSelect **Run all cells** to execute the program. Use the code button in a cell to edit its source.";
element1.append(element2);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n    "));

const element3 = document.createElement("script");
element3.setAttribute("type", "tp/javascript");
element3.textContent = "console.log('Hello from JavaScript');";
element1.append(element3);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
====
